args.prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sheet, The Language Wing. Use the original reference PNGs for the established organic full-body ink monster morphology and modeling. Exactly six whole independent standalone dark charcoal-plum goo figures, three columns and two rows, landscape 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Every face is sculpted directly into its continuous organic blob. Think six different compact asymmetrical drips, rounded pears, commas and irregular splats, as varied as the original family. Maintain each individual silhouette, with natural soft little lobes at the sides and bottom, sometimes no distinct foot shape. A short round or tapered bottom is welcome. Do not use a standard flared base, wide flat skirt, common lobe row, humanoid chest or cut-off bust. Clothing is just a small removable accessory and props sit close to the side or belly with the lower body visible. Thick sculpted dark lids, white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Soft satin clay, sparse broad hand modeling marks, distinct moods, tiny ink hands. No inherited costume, wing or eyepatch, scenery, floor, shadow, frame or text beyond specified prop marks. Preserve generous transparent separation and exterior margin. Rust, cream and marine teal, small scarf tabs and collar pins.
Row-major roles:
1. Female-read German teacher. wide scalloped blob, stern downward concentration. Key cue: three chunky sentence tiles fitted like a tiny bridge.
2. Male-read English teacher. tall bent teardrop, hopeful side-eye. Key cue: two small clay speech tokens with pictograms of a bee and a capital B.
3. Female-read French teacher. upright reverse comma, lifted eyebrow and pursed lips. Key cue: small slate with a single sculpted è and a chalk nub.
4. Male-read Spanish teacher. broad lopsided pear, delighted open smile. Key cue: small tilde-shaped clay piece held just above a miniature lowercase n block.
5. Male-read Latin teacher. low rounded trapezoid, weary half lids, tight smile. Key cue: miniature wax tablet with a short rounded stylus.
6. Male-read German as a second language teacher. narrow wavy splat, encouraging tilted gaze. Key cue: little key and two large picture cards with a door and an apple.
Each actor has a distinct complete compact ink contour from crown to lower edge and one clean readable subject or role prop.

material_change: Gentle charcoal/plum satin clay with broader sparse surface marks and smoother liquid, plastic and glass props.
